name: Unverified USDC/WETH liquidity pool credits nested reentrant liquidity additions against one payment
summary: Unverified pool 0x39ed372f8e9f316029994ca7f73b6683829c6b08 records liquidity and tick reserves in function 0xbe16634e before settlement, then calls back msg.sender without a reentrancy guard and checks payment per call. The attacker re-entered the add path 20 levels deep from the callback, paid once in the deepest frame to satisfy every nested balance check, and then removed the inflated liquidity, taking the pool's entire 7,167.42 USDC and 2.05 WETH.
notes: Direct unverified runtime with no DELEGATECALL or SELFDESTRUCT and an empty EIP-1967 implementation slot, created by CREATE2 from factory 0x6ed3c23f3c4cd1103d7f782e8e38403a4be0e24c; the pool has no admin transactions before the exploit, so deployment is the only code change.
The pool's full pre-exploit USDC and WETH balances, net of the attacker's own deposits in the transaction. The attacker's separate Uniswap V3 USDC->WETH swap is its own trade and not counted.
The pool runtime is unverified; the reentrant accounting is established from the exploit trace and BlockSec's analysis, not from source.
